Container.Name: finalarr
Container.Overview: Season-finale and season-complete notifier for Sonarr. Tells you once when new episodes are on disk, when the season finale has landed and when a season is complete (AniList cross-check for anime, split cours included), and what you are still waiting for: announced seasons and sequels, postponed episodes, the next air date. Calendar with iCal feed. Telegram, Discord, Pushover, webhooks or any Apprise URL. Web UI in German and English. A project by abrechen2 (https://www.abrechen2.de/en/).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web UI, API and Sonarr webhook

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Required, at least 20 characters (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Also your login.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Required. Encrypts stored Sonarr keys and channel URLs. Generate in the Unraid terminal: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' — keep it; changing it makes stored secrets unreadable.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional address you open Finalarr at; adds links to messages.

Config.Name: Login from home network
Config.Description: required = API key everywhere; local = no login from private addresses (behind a reverse proxy also set Trusted proxies)

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front of Finalarr (e.g. 1 behind Nginx Proxy Manager)

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: true when you open Finalarr through a reverse proxy with HTTPS: the login cookie is then only sent over HTTPS

Config.Name: Calendar feed URL
Config.Description: Optional public base URL that serves only /ical/ (e.g. through a reverse proxy), shown as the subscription address so Google or Outlook can reach the feed

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional (themoviedb.org): earlier season announcements, where to watch per country, trailers

Config.Name: Watch region
Config.Description: Country for where to watch (ISO code, e.g. DE, US, GB)

Config.Name: Trakt client id
Config.Description: Optional (trakt.tv): another source for season announcements
